title: Stateful Report Server ID request and response exchange
purpose: Provide a complete two-message valid exchange around the 0x11 path to exercise both request parsing and response handling while preserving coherent transaction and length relationships.
expected_behavior: Client should correlate the response to the request by transaction and unit identifier and process a normal Report Server ID style payload without desynchronization.
constraints_preserved: 7-byte MBAP header preserved in both messages
Protocol identifier set to 0x0000 in both messages
Request MBAP length 0x0002 matches unit identifier plus 1-byte PDU
Response MBAP length 0x0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
Transaction identifier is consistent across request and response
Function code 0x11 is documented for Report Server ID
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe stateful analogue for length-handling concerns: both frames have internally consistent MBAP lengths and avoid the incorrect-length forms cited in historical reports.
